description: Set a character's base animation from the anime catalog. The (group, category, no) triple must come from studio_search_catalog with catalog='anime'. This only changes the animation clip — it does not touch IK/FK targets or expressions; use studio_set_character_pose for a full body pose. Note that the anime catalog is not sex-filtered (Studio does not filter it either), so a clip authored for the other sex will load but may look wrong.

normalized_time.description: where to start inside the clip, in Unity normalized time: the fractional part is the position in the clip, the integer part is the loop count. 0..1 covers one pass. Defaults to 0.

output.description: the character, same shape as one entry of studio_list_characters
